create_skeleton: create a Skeleton object from parent indices, left joints list, and right joints list
query_skeleton_parents: query the parent array of a Skeleton to understand joint hierarchy
query_skeleton_children: query which joints have children and their child mappings in a Skeleton
remove_skeleton_joints: remove specified joints from a Skeleton and reindex remaining joints
query_skeleton_joints_left: query the left-side joint indices of a Skeleton for symmetry operations
